title: Mouse RNASeq data for cancer-associated intratumoral microbial communities
author: Williams, Nyelia
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Administer antibiotic cycles
steps.instruction: Give 22 C57BL/6J mice antibiotic cocktail in drinking water for 5 days, then 2 days regular water; repeat this cycle three times (low‑absorption → high‑absorption → low‑absorption). Low‑absorption cocktail: ertapenem 1 mg/mL (Merck), Neomycin 1 mg/mL (Fagron), Vancomycin 1 mg/mL (Mylan). High‑absorption cocktail: ampicillin 1 mg/mL (Sandoz), cefoperazone 1 mg/mL (Thermo Scientific), clindamycin 1 mg/mL (Major Pharmaceuticals).

steps.title: Inject MC38 tumor cells
steps.instruction: Three days before the final antibiotic water phase ends, inject 1 × 10⁶ MC38 cells subcutaneously into the right flank of each mouse.

steps.title: Gavage stool slurry
steps.instruction: After the antibiotic course, gavage each mouse with 200 µL stool slurry (prepared from 1 g healthy donor stool suspended in 5 mL de‑gassed PBS). Administer slurry either with 1 × 10⁷ CFU B. massiliensis strain FDAARGOS (n = 10) or without bacteria (n = 12) three days after tumor cell injection.

steps.title: Treat with anti‑PD1 antibody
steps.instruction: Ten days after tumor growth begins, inject mice intraperitoneally with 5 mg/kg anti‑PD‑1 antibody (clone RMP1‑14; BioXCell) or an isotype control IgG (clone 2A3; BioXCell).

steps.title: Terminate experiment and euthanize
steps.instruction: End the study 21 days after MC38 injection and euthanize the mice.

steps.title: Sterile tumor dissection
steps.instruction: Immediately after euthanasia, dissect tumors under sterile conditions.

steps.title: Extract RNA with bead‑beating
steps.instruction: Minced tumor tissue with a scalpel, add lysis buffer and 100 mg ceramic beads, then bead‑beat at 2000 rpm for 2 min using a PowerLyzer 24 (QIAGEN). Purify total RNA using the AllPrep kit (QIAGEN) per the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Deplete host RNA
steps.instruction: Remove human and mouse RNA using the KAPA RNA HyperPrep kit (Roche) according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Sequence RNA libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NextSeq 2000 with 2 × 150 nt reads, targeting a depth of 50 million reads per sample.
